summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate (Rochester Institute of Technology) building deployed perception pipelines for robotics, spanning object detection, depth based 3D reconstruction, and CUDA accelerated inference. Hands on experience deploying TensorRT-optimized YOLO for visual servoing and contact-aware grasping on a real robotic pick-and-place system, plus quantizing deep learning models in PyTorch and TensorFlow for edge deployment.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.
Designed a custom wavelet bank (alpha-blended sym6+bior3.5) to suppress low-frequency noise; combined with optimized homography stitching and concurrency to achieve a PSNR of 86.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a custom object detection dataset for health-level classification using YOLOv8.
Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) in PyTorch using HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API; improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93%.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated faster-whisper STT (1.0-1.4s), Gemini intent classification (<500ms), and TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2x speedup: 56.7->10.9 ms, 17.6->92 FPS vs eager PyTorch) for visual servoing, plus dual VL53L0X ToF sensors for contact-aware grasping via TCA9548A I2C mux.
Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.

projects.name: ABB RobotStudio Automation Simulation
bullets: Simulated a full ABB RobotStudio workcell for an end-to-end press-to-packing pipeline; programmed in RAPID with TCP socket-based pose acquisition and interrupt-driven logic, validating full-cycle repeatability.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript conv layers in VGG16 with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing and constant memory; coalesced kernel ran at 49.2ms vs 77.5ms CPU TorchScript, a ~35% speedup with identical classification accuracy.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B; benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC with <1% accuracy degradation, a near-lossless compression.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
